(Al Jazeera; cross-ref NPR and CBS News)
Cross-ref URL: https://www.npr.org/2026/08/16/g-s1-138948/kushner-gaza-hamas-netanyahu-egypt-talks

Gaza roadmap diplomacy (mid-to-late Aug 2026, ongoing):
- Jared Kushner held a rare meeting with Hamas leadership in Egypt to push progress in the
  stalled Gaza ceasefire. Hamas political leader Khalil al-Hayya attended, alongside Egyptian
  intelligence chief Hassan Rashad, Qatari diplomat Ali Al Thawadi and a senior Turkish
  official. Kushner then held talks with Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu, which did not produce
  a breakthrough.
- Washington is seeking to implement a 15-point roadmap for Gaza approved by Trump's "Board
  of Peace". Netanyahu, seeking re-election in October, has publicly rejected the plan,
  objecting to a provision under which Hamas would gradually disarm and hand over governance
  to an international force in exchange for an Israeli withdrawal.
- Hamas confirmed acceptance of the roadmap during the Cairo meetings but insisted execution
  depends on Israel fulfilling prior commitments and halting daily "ceasefire" violations.
- Kushner: "We will not allow Gaza to be rebuilt until Hamas disarms."
